messages.subject: UC Davis open source symposium this Friday
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!
Datalab is hosting an Open Source Symposium this Friday (10/24). There are four sessions:

- 9am: A panel discussion featuring five UC Davis professors who are open source developers (including Duncan Temple Lang, a member of the R core team who are responsible for developing the R language and interpreter.)
- 11am: Discovering OS projects
- 12 pm: lunch (catered!) and networking
- 1-4pm: learn to use Git and Github, the main forum for open source collaboration. Taught by Datalab staff. 

Please register – it’s the only way to get the catered lunch! https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/open-source-symposium-2025
-Wes
